titre_exercice: Expression écrite : article, essai ou lettre personnelle au choix
enonce_intro_markdown:
**Exercice 4 (10 points) - SECTION D: COMPOSITION WRITING**

*Write a composition of between 200-250 words on ONE of the following topics.*

questions.enonce_markdown:
**Topic 1.** You are the President of the English Club in GBHS Nsombo. On the occasion of celebrations marking the National Week of Bilingualism, you have been asked to write an article for Cameroon Tribune on the importance of the English Language. In your article:
- state the status of the language in Cameroon,
- explain the importance of the language in social life, education, and other spheres,
- strongly advise students to change negative attitudes towards the English Language. *[10 pts]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un article de journal se distingue d'une lettre ou d'un essai par sa structure propre : un titre accrocheur, une accroche qui capte l'attention dès la première phrase, un corps organisé en paragraphes qui traite point par point les éléments imposés par la consigne, et une conclusion qui relance le lecteur vers l'action ; il ne comporte ni adresse, ni formule d'appel du type "Dear...", ni formule de politesse finale.

La consigne impose trois points à traiter dans l'ordre : le statut de la langue anglaise au Cameroun, son importance dans la vie sociale, l'éducation et d'autres domaines, puis un conseil appuyé aux élèves pour changer d'attitude. Le texte ci-dessous respecte cette structure et le format article, pour un total d'environ 220 mots.

---

**ENGLISH: A LANGUAGE CAMEROON CANNOT AFFORD TO NEGLECT**

*By Nsangou, President of the English Club, GBHS Nsombo*

As Cameroon celebrates another National Week of Bilingualism, it is time to look honestly at how our students really treat the English Language.

English is one of Cameroon's two official languages, spoken alongside French in government offices, schools, courts and the media across the ten regions of the country. Far from being a foreign subject learned only for examinations, English is a working language that every Cameroonian is entitled to use with the same confidence as French.

The importance of English goes well beyond the classroom. In social life, it allows young people from Anglophone and Francophone backgrounds to communicate freely and to build a truly bilingual national identity. In education, English opens access to countless textbooks, research papers and online courses that would otherwise remain out of reach. In business and international relations, fluency in English gives Cameroonian graduates an edge in a job market that increasingly operates in English, from call centres to multinational companies operating in our cities.

Sadly, many students still see English as a difficult subject to be avoided rather than mastered. This attitude must change. I strongly urge every student to stop fearing mistakes, to practise speaking English daily with classmates, and to see the language not as an obstacle, but as a genuine key to opportunity.

Bilingualism is a gift our country has chosen for itself. Let us finally learn to use it.

---

### Piège à éviter
Ne rédige jamais cet article comme une lettre : pas de "Dear Editor," en ouverture ni de formule de clôture comme "Yours faithfully". Le format article se signale par un titre et, si besoin, une mention de l'auteur, jamais par une adresse.

### Conseil
Traite les trois points de la consigne dans des paragraphes séparés et bien identifiables : un correcteur qui relit vite doit pouvoir repérer immédiatement où tu réponds à chacune des trois exigences.

questions.enonce_markdown: **Topic 2.** You have noticed that many teenagers in your community are abandoning school because of unwanted pregnancies. Write an essay in which you state the dangers of premarital sex. Also try to advise parents, children and the community at large on what to do to help youths, especially the girl child, to stop this phenomenon. *[10 pts]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai argumentatif se structure en une introduction qui présente le sujet et annonce le plan, un développement qui organise les idées en paragraphes distincts, et une conclusion qui résume la position défendue.

La consigne demande deux mouvements distincts : d'abord exposer les dangers du sexe avant le mariage, puis conseiller séparément les parents, les enfants et la communauté. Le texte ci-dessous suit un plan en trois paragraphes de développement après l'introduction, pour respecter cette double exigence en environ 230 mots.

---

**THE DANGERS OF PREMARITAL SEX AMONG TEENAGERS**

In many communities today, including ours, an increasing number of teenagers are dropping out of school because of unwanted pregnancies. This alarming trend calls for urgent reflection on the dangers of premarital sex and on what parents, children and the community can do to reverse it.

Premarital sex exposes teenagers to serious risks. Unwanted pregnancies force many girls to abandon their education permanently, destroying years of academic effort and future career prospects. Beyond pregnancy, unprotected sexual activity also exposes young people to sexually transmitted infections, including HIV/AIDS, which can affect their health for life. Socially, teenage parents often face rejection, shame and financial hardship, since they are rarely prepared, emotionally or economically, to raise a child.

To stop this phenomenon, every actor has a role to play. Parents should talk openly with their children about relationships and sexuality instead of treating the subject as taboo, and they should supervise their children's friendships more closely. Children and teenagers themselves must learn to say no to pressure from partners or peers, and to understand that saying no does not make them less loved or less popular. The community, through churches, schools and youth associations, should organise regular sensitisation campaigns on the dangers of premarital sex and on responsible behaviour, with special attention to the girl child, who bears the heaviest consequences.

If parents, children and the community act together, fewer girls will have to sacrifice their education and their future because of a single moment of pressure or carelessness.

---

### Piège à éviter
Ne te contente pas d'énumérer les dangers sans répondre à la seconde partie de la consigne : un essai qui oublie les conseils aux parents, aux enfants et à la communauté ne traite que la moitié du sujet demandé, même s'il est bien écrit.

### Conseil
Consacre un paragraphe distinct à chaque acteur mentionné dans la consigne, parents, enfants, communauté : cela rend ta réponse facile à noter point par point et montre que tu as traité chaque exigence explicitement.

questions.enonce_markdown: **Topic 3.** The Ministry of Tourism has just opened a beautiful touristic site in your village. Write a letter to your friend Annabel in Germany who wants to visit your country. Describe the site and state clearly why you think your friend will like it. Also state the importance of this attraction to the social and economic life of the village. Your name is Nsangou, and your village is Idenau. *[10 pts]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre personnelle adressée à un ami suit une mise en page fixe : l'adresse de l'expéditeur et la date en haut, une formule d'appel chaleureuse ("Dear Annabel,"), un corps de lettre organisé en paragraphes, une formule de clôture amicale et la signature ; ce format diffère nettement de celui d'un article ou d'un essai.

La consigne impose trois contenus précis dans le corps de la lettre : la description du site touristique, les raisons pour lesquelles Annabel l'aimerait, et l'importance du site pour la vie sociale et économique du village. Le texte ci-dessous respecte la mise en page d'une lettre personnelle et développe ces trois points en environ 210 mots.

---

Idenau

Cameroon

15 September 2022

Dear Annabel,

I hope this letter finds you well in Germany. I have wonderful news: the Ministry of Tourism has just opened a beautiful touristic site right here in Idenau, and I immediately thought of you, since you told me you wanted to visit Cameroon.

The site sits along our stretch of coastline, where black volcanic sand meets clear blue water, with Mount Cameroon rising in the background. There are guided nature trails through the surrounding forest, small fishing boats you can hire for a trip along the coast, and local restaurants serving fresh grilled fish and traditional dishes.

I am sure you will love it, because it combines exactly what you enjoy: hiking, photography and discovering new cultures. The mix of mountain, forest and ocean in one single place is rare, and the local community is famous for its warm welcome to visitors.

This site is already changing life in Idenau. It has created jobs for young guides, boat owners and craft sellers, and it brings much-needed income to families who used to depend only on fishing and farming. Socially, it has also given our village a new sense of pride, as visitors from all over the world now come to see what we always knew was beautiful.

Please start planning your trip. I would be delighted to show you around myself.

Your friend,

Nsangou

---

### Piège à éviter
N'oublie jamais l'adresse et la date en tête de lettre, ni la formule de clôture amicale suivie de la signature : une lettre personnelle sans ces éléments de mise en page perd des points, même si le contenu répond bien à la consigne.

### Conseil
Reprends le nom et le lieu donnés par l'énoncé, ici Nsangou et Idenau, exactement tels quels dans la signature et l'adresse : un correcteur vérifie souvent que ces détails imposés sont bien repris.
